官方地图产品入口，可进入地图服务并了解导航与地点保存功能。: Official Maps product entry point, with access to mapping, navigation and saved places.
支持多种交通方式，并可按出发或到达日期时间规划路线。: Supports multiple travel modes and directions based on departure or arrival date and time.
离线状态不提供公交、步行或骑行导航，也没有实时交通。: Offline mode does not provide transit, walking or cycling directions, or live traffic.
湾区交通数据向地图与出行应用提供，包括 Google、Apple 和 Trans: Bay Area transportation data is supplied to mapping and travel applications, including Google, Apple and Transit.
比较开车、公交、步行与骑行路线，也方便保存酒店和景点入口。: Compare driving, transit, walking and cycling routes, and save hotel and attraction entrances.
适合第一次来湾区、一天跨几个街区或城市的游客。: For first-time Bay Area visitors traveling between neighborhoods or cities in one day.
输入具体入口，设置出发或到达日期时间，再比较换乘与步行段；回程也单独查一次。: Enter the specific entrance, set your departure or arrival date and time, and compare transfers and walking sections. Check the return trip separately.
离线地图不能提供公交、步行或骑行导航；实时到站与临时停运仍需核对运营方公告。: Offline maps do not provide transit, walking or cycling directions. Check the operator's notices for live arrivals and service disruptions.
湾区各县可查地图和路线；公交信息完整度取决于当地运营方的数据。: Maps and routes cover the Bay Area; transit information depends on data supplied by local operators.
官方入口介绍旧金山详细地图、路线及可用地区的实时公交信息。: The official entry point describes detailed San Francisco maps, directions and live transit information where available.
网页地图支持多种桌面及移动浏览器，功能可能因平台而异。: Maps on the web supports multiple desktop and mobile browsers; features can vary by platform.
区域交通数据提供给 Apple 等合作应用。: Regional transportation data is supplied to partner applications including Apple.
在苹果设备上查询路线、公交到站与地点，也有网页入口。: Look up routes, transit arrivals and places on Apple devices, with a web entry point also available.
适合使用 iPhone 的游客和希望收藏日常目的地的新居民。: For visitors using an iPhone and new residents saving everyday destinations.
先确认目的地入口，再选公交或驾车；把住宿和车站加入收藏，出发前查看路线提醒。: Confirm the destination entrance, then select transit or driving. Save your accommodation and stations, and check route alerts before leaving.
网页与原生应用的功能不完全相同；支持的浏览器、语言和地区功能要按官方说明核对。: Web and native-app features differ. Check Apple's documentation for supported browsers, languages and regional features.
官方列有旧金山详细城市地图；湾区公交显示内容取决于线路与实时数据。: Apple lists San Francisco among its detailed city maps; Bay Area transit information varies by route and live data availability.
列出湾区支持的运营方，并提供应用下载、路线规划、到站与服务提醒。: Lists supported Bay Area operators and provides app downloads, trip planning, arrivals and service alerts.
部分扩展功能通过 Royale 提供，可能有交通机构赞助。: Some extended features are provided through Royale, which may be sponsored by a transit agency.
集中查看附近公交、列车、渡轮到站信息，并给出换乘步骤。: See nearby bus, train and ferry arrivals together with step-by-step transfer directions.
适合经常跨运营方换乘、希望少切换几个应用的人。: For people transferring between operators who want to switch between fewer apps.
选好出行方向与日期，查看附近站点和服务提醒；复杂行程可跟随逐段导航。: Select your direction and travel date, check nearby stops and service alerts, and use step-by-step navigation for complex trips.
到站时间是数据预测；部分完整时刻与扩展功能需要 Royale，先看免费或机构赞助: Arrival times are predictions. Some full schedules and extended features require Royale; check what is free or sponsored by your agency.
官方湾区目录包含 Muni、BART、Caltrain、AC Transit、V: Its official Bay Area directory includes Muni, BART, Caltrain, AC Transit, VTA, SMART and ferry services.
说明应用管理、手机钱包、卡片转移与实体卡停用的区别。: Explains app-based account management, mobile wallets, card transfers and deactivation of the plastic card for transit.
2026 年 9 月 1 日起停售单程票；部分其他票种在 2026 年继续销售，: Single-ride ticket sales ended September 1, 2026. Some other fare products remain on sale in 2026; the full transition is not yet complete.
管理湾区交通卡余额与票种，并把交通卡加入手机钱包。: Manage Bay Area transit-card balances and passes, and add a transit card to your mobile wallet.
适合跨公交、轨道与渡轮出行，或需要管理优惠交通卡的人。: For travel across buses, rail and ferries, or for managing a discounted transit card.
注册卡片后按指引加入 Apple Wallet 或 Google Wallet；: Register your card and follow the instructions to add it to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet. Before entering, confirm the card is ready on your device and funded.
仅注册实体卡不能直接刷手机；转入钱包后实体卡停用于乘车。MuniMobile 已: Registering a plastic card alone does not enable phone tapping. Transferring it to a wallet deactivates the plastic card for transit. MuniMobile no longer sells single-ride tickets, but some passes remain.
限参与 Clipper 的湾区运营方；具体优惠与进出站刷卡规则按线路确认。: Available on participating Bay Area operators; confirm discounts and tap-on/tap-off rules for each service.
官方应用提供行程规划、实时到站、服务与电梯提醒和停车功能。: The official app provides trip planning, live arrivals, service and elevator alerts, and parking features.
说明停车产品与付款，停车费不能由 Clipper 余额支付。: Explains parking products and payment; parking cannot be paid from Clipper balance.
查询 BART 路线、实时列车、服务提醒，也能处理车站停车。: Check BART routes, live trains and service alerts, and manage station parking.
适合搭 BART 通勤、机场转乘或把车停在车站的乘客。: For BART commuters, airport transfers and riders parking at a station.
先选起终点并查末班车与电梯提醒；停车另进停车功能，核对车牌、站点和所选停车产品。: Choose your origin and destination and check the last train and elevator alerts. For parking, open the parking feature and verify your plate, station and parking product.
停车支付与车费分开，Clipper 余额不能支付停车；预留车位与普通日停也有不同: Parking and transit fares are separate: Clipper balance cannot pay for parking. Reserved and daily parking have different conditions.
覆盖 BART 系统；接续 Muni、Caltrain 或其他公交时要另查相应运: Covers the BART system; check the relevant operator separately for connecting Muni, Caltrain or bus services.
介绍时刻查询、不同停站服务、南县接驳及上车前支付要求。: Explains schedule lookup, stopping patterns, South County connections and the requirement to pay before boarding.
旧购票应用于 2025 年 10 月 31 日停止使用，转用 Clipper 或: The old ticketing app retired on October 31, 2025; riders should use current options such as Clipper or ticket machines.
用官网查半岛铁路时刻、停站和服务变化，再选择现行购票方式。: Use the website to check Peninsula rail schedules, stops and service changes, then choose a current ticketing method.
适合旧金山、半岛与南湾之间通勤或安排一日游的人。: For commuting or day trips between San Francisco, the Peninsula and the South Bay.
按工作日或周末查出发站与列车停站；上车前购票或刷卡，使用 Clipper 时在目: Choose the weekday or weekend schedule and check your station and train's stops. Buy a ticket or tap before boarding; tap off at your destination when using Clipper.
旧 Caltrain Mobile 已于 2025 年 10 月 31 日停用；: The old Caltrain Mobile app retired on October 31, 2025. Viewing a timetable does not buy a ticket, and stopping patterns differ by train.
主线连接旧金山与圣何塞；Gilroy 方向南县接驳另查工作日服务安排。: The main line links San Francisco and San Jose; check the separate weekday South County service toward Gilroy.
提供实时交通、公交及骑行提醒、区域地图、运营方资源和电话服务。: Provides live traffic, transit and cycling alerts, a regional map, operator resources and telephone information.
解释区域资讯服务及使用其他应用规划行程的入口。: Explains the regional information service and links to other applications for trip planning.
汇总湾区道路、公交与骑行服务提醒，适合出门前查大范围变化。: Brings together Bay Area road, transit and cycling alerts for checking regional disruptions before leaving.
适合跨县出行、赶大型活动，或需要道路与公共交通备选的人。: For cross-county journeys, major events, or comparing road and public-transport alternatives.
打开地图与提醒，按行程区域查看事故或交通调整，再进入运营方链接确认当天安排。: Open the map and alerts, check incidents or service changes along your route, then follow the operator link to confirm that day's arrangements.
它是区域资讯入口，不是通用购票钱包；逐步路线规划可接地图应用，具体班次以运营方为: This is a regional information service, not a universal ticket wallet. Use a mapping app for turn-by-turn planning and the operator for specific services.
面向整个湾区，包含桥梁、快速车道和公共交通资源；也提供电话 511 查询入口。: Serves the Bay Area with bridge, express-lane and transit resources, plus traveler information by calling 511.
旧金山官方乘车入口，提供行程与可用车型查询。: Official San Francisco ride entry point, with trip and available vehicle-option lookup.
确认奥克兰有官方乘车服务入口。: Confirms an official ride-service entry point for Oakland.
确认圣何塞有官方乘车服务入口。: Confirms an official ride-service entry point for San Jose.
机场上车点按应用内指引确认，车辆接单与最终费用有条件限制。: Airport pickup locations should be confirmed in the app; ride acceptance and final charges are subject to conditions.
通过手机或网页申请网约车，适合行李多或公共交通接不上时使用。: Request a ride through the app or website when carrying luggage or when transit connections are impractical.
适合机场接送、多人分摊行程和夜间最后一段接驳。: For airport transfers, shared group journeys and the final connection at night.
输入准确上车点与目的地，比较车型和报价后确认；机场按订单显示的楼层与上车区集合。: Enter the exact pickup point and destination, compare vehicle options and quotes, then confirm. At airports, meet at the level and pickup area shown in your booking.
报价会受需求、路线和过路费影响；预估到车时间及附近车辆不等于保证接单。: Quotes depend on demand, route and tolls. Estimated pickup times and nearby vehicles do not guarantee that a driver will accept.
旧金山、奥克兰、圣何塞等有官方服务页；远郊和具体机场行程按当时地址查询。: Official service pages cover San Francisco, Oakland and San Jose, among others. Check the exact addresses for outlying areas and airport trips.
介绍旧金山叫车服务、应用入口及需求和附加费对价格的影响。: Describes San Francisco ride service, the app entry point, and how demand and surcharges affect prices.
官方服务城市目录包含旧金山、奥克兰与圣何塞。: The official service-city directory includes San Francisco, Oakland and San Jose.
官方机场目录包含 SFO、OAK 与 SJC，机场上车需按指定区域执行。: The official airport directory includes SFO, OAK and SJC; pickups must follow the airport's designated arrangements.
用应用叫车并比较车型，是公交接驳和机场行程的另一选择。: Request rides and compare vehicle options in the app as an alternative for transit connections and airport trips.
适合希望与其他叫车平台对比等待时间和总价的人。: For people comparing wait times and total prices across ride-hailing services.
设定实际路边上车位置、目的地与人数，查看车型报价；机场按照应用提示去指定上车区。: Set your actual curbside pickup point, destination and party size, then review vehicle quotes. At airports, follow the app to the designated pickup area.
繁忙时段价格可能提高，过路费或附加费也会影响总价；下单前看当前报价，不套用旧优惠: Prices can rise during busy periods, and tolls or surcharges can affect the total. Check the current quote before booking rather than relying on old promotions.
官方城市与机场目录列有旧金山、奥克兰、圣何塞及其主要机场；具体地址以应用可叫车范: Official city and airport directories list San Francisco, Oakland, San Jose and their main airports; the app determines availability for your exact addresses.
官方乘车与应用入口，实际叫车在应用中进行。: Official ride and app entry point; rides are requested in the app.
官方服务区域页列有旧金山湾区，具体边界通过服务地图及应用确认。: The official service-area page lists the San Francisco Bay Area; use the service map and app to confirm boundaries.
2026 年 5 月公布更多 San Jose 与 Campbell 可服务地点: A May 2026 announcement adds more service locations in San Jose and Campbell.
在开放服务范围内叫无人驾驶车，适合有明确起终点的市区行程。: Request a driverless ride within the active service area for trips with specific pickup and destination addresses.
适合想体验自动驾驶、且能接受指定上车位置的游客和居民。: For visitors and residents who want to try driverless rides and can use the designated pickup point.
先在应用输入起点和终点，确认两端都能服务，再检查上车位置、等待时间与本次报价。: Enter both endpoints in the app and confirm they are supported, then check the pickup location, wait time and quote for that trip.
开放运营地图会更新，不能把测试范围当作载客范围；机场及跨区行程需逐单查询。: The operating map changes. Testing areas are not the same as passenger-service areas; check each airport or cross-area trip individually.
覆盖旧金山及半岛、南湾部分区域，已扩展更多 San Jose 与 Campbel: Serves San Francisco and parts of the Peninsula and South Bay, including expanded areas of San Jose and Campbell; it does not cover the entire Bay Area.
旧金山停车表采用 ParkMobile 与 HotSpot，支持应用、浏览器及访: San Francisco meters use ParkMobile and HotSpot, with app, browser and guest-payment options.
现行说明确认 PayByPhone 已不被 SFMTA 停车表接受；停车位置代码: Current guidance confirms that SFMTA meters no longer accept PayByPhone; drivers must still verify the location code and posted time limits.
官方停车支付与应用入口，按地点、车辆和时长发起支付。: Official parking-payment and app entry point, using the location, vehicle and duration.
在参与地点用手机或网页支付停车费，旧金山路边停车表可使用。: Pay for parking by app or browser at participating locations, including San Francisco street meters.
适合经常路边短停、希望收到停车到期提醒的驾驶者。: For drivers making short street-parking stops who want expiry reminders.
先读街边标志，再核对停车位置代码、车牌和时长；付款后查看确认记录，按允许范围续时: Read the street signs, verify the parking location code, plate and duration, then check payment confirmation. Extend only within the permitted limits.
手机付款可能另收便利费，也不能突破街道最长停留限制；不要仅凭地图定位选停车区。: Mobile payment may include a convenience fee and does not override the street's maximum stay. Do not choose the parking zone from GPS alone.
SFMTA 停车表接受；湾区其他城市或场库仅限现场明确标示支持的地点。: Accepted at SFMTA meters; elsewhere in the Bay Area, use it only where the city or facility explicitly supports it.
官方说明支持应用或浏览器、账户或访客付款，并提供美国付款入口。: Official instructions support app or browser payment, with an account or as a guest, and link to the US payment portal.
可用应用或网页支付参与地点的停车费，也是旧金山停车表现役选项。: Pay for parking at participating locations by app or browser; it is a current option for San Francisco meters.
适合偶尔停车、希望使用网页访客流程而不常装应用的人。: For occasional drivers who prefer a browser-based guest flow to regularly using an app.
从官网进入付款页，按停车表上的代码输入位置、车牌和时长，确认费用后保留付款结果。: Open the payment page from the official website, enter the meter's location code, your plate and duration, then review the charge and retain confirmation.
续时仍受现场最长停车限制；显示可付款不代表可以停在装卸区或临时禁停范围。: Extensions remain subject to the posted maximum stay. A payment option does not authorize parking in loading areas or temporary no-parking zones.
覆盖 SFMTA 指定停车表及其他合作地点；跨城市时先看当地停车标志接受哪种平台: Covers designated SFMTA meters and other partner locations; check each city's parking signs to see which platform is accepted.
官方入口提供应用下载与网页停车付款。: The official entry point provides app downloads and web parking payment.
Presidio 停车可使用 PayByPhone 或现场付费机，费率按位置与日: Presidio parking can be paid through PayByPhone or on-site pay stations; rates vary by location and date.
为明确支持的平台地点支付停车费，在 Presidio 仍有实际用途。: Pay for parking at locations that explicitly accept the platform; it remains useful in the Presidio.
适合去 Presidio 游玩，或已确认停车场接受该平台的驾驶者。: For drivers visiting the Presidio or a parking facility that confirms acceptance of the platform.
到场查看停车牌与位置代码，输入正确车牌和所需时长，再核对付款成功；也可看现场售票: Read the parking sign and location code, enter the correct plate and duration, and confirm successful payment. Check on-site pay-station options as well.
SFMTA 路边停车表已停止接受 PayByPhone，不能照旧攻略付款；各停车: SFMTA street meters no longer accept PayByPhone, so do not rely on older guides. Check rates and restrictions for each location.
Presidio 官方仍列 PayByPhone；不能据此推断旧金山所有停车表或: The Presidio still officially lists PayByPhone; this does not imply acceptance at every San Francisco meter or in other Bay Area cities.
提供旧金山合作停车场库的按时段搜索与预约入口。: Provides time-based search and reservation access for participating San Francisco parking facilities.
说明 Parking Pass 入场、车型限制、进出次数与订单取消等条件。: Explains Parking Pass entry, vehicle restrictions, re-entry and booking-cancellation conditions.
按目的地与时间比较并预付合作车库、停车场的位置。: Compare and prepay for spaces at participating garages and lots by destination and time.
适合开车看演出、去市中心或想在出发前确定停车方案的人。: For drivers heading to performances or downtown, or wanting a parking plan before departure.
输入到场与离场时间，查看入口地址、限高和车型要求；订好后按 Parking Pa: Enter arrival and departure times and check the entrance address, height clearance and vehicle requirements. Follow your Parking Pass instructions on arrival.
不是路边停车表付款；多数地点不能反复进出，超时与超大车辆费用、取消条件按订单确认: This is not street-meter payment. Most locations do not allow repeated entry; check your booking for overtime, oversized-vehicle charges and cancellation terms.
旧金山及湾区有合作库存，是否有合适场库取决于目标地址、日期和时段。: Participating inventory is available in San Francisco and the Bay Area; suitable options depend on your address, date and time.
官方骑行说明提供应用入口、解锁与还桩绿色确认灯步骤，也支持网上选择会员。: Official riding instructions provide app access, unlocking and green-light dock confirmation, plus online membership selection.
旧金山部分带锁电助力车可按指定规则停公共车架，其他列明城市仍须还桩。: Some San Francisco e-bikes with locks may use public racks under the specified rules; the other listed cities still require docking.
区域官网列出 Bay Wheels 在旧金山、东湾和圣何塞的服务及地图查询入口。: The regional website lists Bay Wheels service in San Francisco, the East Bay and San Jose, with a map lookup.
查询共享单车与车桩，解决车站到目的地的短途接驳。: Find shared bikes and docks for short connections between transit stations and your destination.
适合能骑车、行李不多，并愿意按指定规则还车的人。: For riders with little luggage who can cycle and return the bike according to the designated rules.
先在应用查可用车辆和目的地车桩，选择骑行方案后解锁；还桩时等绿色确认灯并检查行程: Check available bikes and destination docks in the app, choose a ride option and unlock. At a dock, wait for the green confirmation light and check that the trip has ended.
电助力车与普通车计费不同；旧金山部分电助力车可按规则锁车架，不能把此规则套到所有: E-bikes and classic bikes have different pricing. Some San Francisco e-bikes may be locked to racks under the stated rules; this does not apply to every city.
服务旧金山、东湾部分城市和圣何塞；逐点查应用中的服务区、停车点及可能的还车附加费: Serves San Francisco, parts of the East Bay and San Jose. Check the app for service areas, parking points and any return surcharges.
官方通行费账户、付款和收费地点入口。: Official entry point for toll accounts, payment and toll locations.
区分桥梁和快速车道可用的付款方式及标签要求。: Distinguishes payment options and tag requirements for bridges and express lanes.
租车可选不同付费方案；自有账户需车牌起止日期，短期车牌账户仅用于桥梁。: Rental cars have several toll-payment options. An existing account requires plate start and end dates; Short-Term License Plate Accounts are for bridges only.
管理湾区收费桥梁与快速车道账户，查询或支付相关通行费。: Manage Bay Area toll-bridge and express-lane accounts and look up or pay the associated tolls.
适合自驾跨桥、新购车，或需要安排租车过路费的游客。: For drivers crossing bridges, new vehicle owners and visitors arranging rental-car toll payment.
先分清桥梁与快速车道，再选账户和设备；租车使用自己的账户时添加车牌并设置使用起止: First distinguish bridges from express lanes, then choose the appropriate account and tag. If using your own account with a rental, add its plate and set start and end dates.
短期车牌账户不能支付快速车道；快速车道需有效标签，租车公司方案还可能收服务费。: A Short-Term License Plate Account cannot pay express-lane tolls. Express lanes require a valid tag, and rental-company plans may add service fees.
适用于湾区收费桥梁和指定快速车道；不同道路、拼车优惠与标签条件须分别核对。: Applies to Bay Area toll bridges and designated express lanes; check each road's rules, carpool discounts and tag requirements.
